name: Terra Space - Phase 5 - Generate and Qualify Events

nodes.name: When I Click Execute Workflow
nodes.notes: Owner-started only. The workflow remains inactive during Phase 5 development.

nodes.name: MCP Run Trigger
nodes.notes: Dedicated owner-controlled MCP trigger. Keep the workflow inactive except while starting an explicitly approved run.

nodes.name: Get Pending Phase 5A Records
nodes.notes: Reads every eligible pending Phase 5A record. Full processing still requires an owner-started manual execution.

nodes.name: Any Pending Phase 5A Records?
nodes.notes: Routes real pending Phase 5A rows into Phase 5A processing. When the queue is empty, the control item safely bypasses Phase 5A writes and starts Phase 5B.

nodes.name: Process One Record at a Time
nodes.notes: Processes exactly one pending Phase 5A record at a time.

nodes.name: Prepare Phase 5A Record
nodes.notes: Deterministically copies approved upstream fields and routes VALID to NORMAL, otherwise LIMITED. Eligible record-level transform errors become retryable FAILED rows. No model call or enrichment.

nodes.name: Is Failed Retry?
nodes.notes: Only a latest technical FAILED Phase 5A record can arrive here with an existing ID.

nodes.name: Update Failed Phase 5A Record
nodes.notes: Updates only the exact retryable FAILED latest row. It never deletes and reinserts.

nodes.name: Create Phase 5A Record
nodes.notes: Creates one latest Phase 5A event record for a first attempt.

nodes.name: Append Phase 5A Processing Run
nodes.notes: Appends one immutable history snapshot after the latest-row write succeeds.

nodes.name: Phase 5A Complete
nodes.notes: Single safe handoff into Phase 5B after either completing real Phase 5A rows or confirming that Phase 5A has no pending rows.

nodes.name: Get Pending Phase 5B Events
nodes.notes: Reads only PREPARED Phase 5A rows with no final Phase 5B result or an exact retryable FAILED result.

nodes.name: Get Active Event Types
nodes.notes: Validates the exact 12 active definitions supplied by the protected pending view.

nodes.name: Process One Phase 5B Event at a Time
nodes.notes: Processes exactly one Phase 5B event at a time.

nodes.name: Prepare Classification Attempt
nodes.notes: Creates local processing metadata and a unique history submission key.

nodes.name: Build Classifier Prompt
nodes.notes: Builds the bounded evidence-only classifier prompt and preserves retry feedback.

parameters.jsonBody: ={{ { model: 'google/gemma-4-12b-qat', messages: [{ role: 'user', content: $json.classifier_prompt }], temperature: 0.1, max_tokens: 1024, reasoning_effort: 'none', response_format: $json.classifier_response_format } }}

nodes.name: Classify Event Type (LM Studio)
nodes.notes: Local classifier call only.

nodes.name: Parse Classifier Output
nodes.notes: Strict exact-type and evidence-grounded proposal parser.

nodes.name: Classification Parsed?
nodes.notes: Valid semantic output reaches safeguard; failure reaches persistence.

nodes.name: Build Safeguard Prompt
nodes.notes: Builds the independent bounded safeguard prompt.

parameters.jsonBody: ={{ { model: 'google/gemma-4-12b-qat', messages: [{ role: 'user', content: $json.safeguard_prompt }], temperature: 0.1, max_tokens: 1024, reasoning_effort: 'none', response_format: $json.safeguard_response_format } }}

nodes.name: Safeguard Event Type (LM Studio)
nodes.notes: Independent local safeguard call.

nodes.name: Apply Safeguard Decision
nodes.notes: Applies ACCEPT/REJECT, two corrective retries, conservative fallback, and audit trace.

nodes.name: Retry Classification?
nodes.notes: Retries return to classifier; final records continue to persistence.

nodes.name: Existing Failed Classification?
nodes.notes: Only an exact FAILED latest result can be updated.

nodes.name: Update Failed Phase 5B Classification
nodes.notes: Updates only the exact retryable FAILED row.

nodes.name: Create Phase 5B Classification
nodes.notes: Creates the first latest Phase 5B classification.

nodes.name: Append Phase 5B Classification Run
nodes.notes: Appends one immutable Phase 5B history snapshot.

nodes.name: Has Event Type Proposal?
nodes.notes: Only an accepted final Unclassified result can create a proposal.

nodes.name: Create Phase 5B Event Type Proposal
nodes.notes: Creates PENDING_REVIEW only; no taxonomy row is created.

nodes.name: Any Pending Phase 5B Events?
nodes.notes: Routes real pending Phase 5B rows to classification and an empty control item to the Phase 5C handoff.

nodes.name: Phase 5B Complete
nodes.notes: Single safe handoff into Phase 5C after completing Phase 5B rows or confirming the Phase 5B queue is empty.

nodes.name: Get Pending Phase 5C Events
nodes.notes: Reads all eligible Phase 5C inputs, including approved references and existing unresolved suggestions. No upstream record is changed.

nodes.name: Prepare Phase 5C Timeline and Geography
nodes.notes: Pure deterministic Phase 5C transformer. Uses only approved references; unresolved names stay visible and never receive invented coordinates.

nodes.name: Prepare Phase 5C Suggestions
nodes.notes: Flattens and batch-deduplicates new SYSTEM_UNRESOLVED suggestions. The input snapshot already excludes existing open suggestions. No model call is used.

nodes.name: Create Phase 5C Reference Suggestion
nodes.notes: Creates batch-deduplicated PENDING_REVIEW suggestions only. It never creates an approved reference or coordinate.

nodes.name: Has Existing Phase 5C Result?
nodes.notes: Only a retryable existing Phase 5C result is updated; first attempts create a row.

nodes.name: Update Failed Phase 5C Result
nodes.notes: Updates only the exact pending-view result identity. No delete or replacement of other rows.

nodes.name: Create Phase 5C Result
nodes.notes: Creates one latest Phase 5C timeline/geography result.

nodes.name: Append Phase 5C Timeline Geography Run
nodes.notes: Appends one immutable Phase 5C history snapshot for each prepared event.

nodes.name: Phase 5C Complete

parameters.jsCode: return [{ json: { phase5c_complete: true } }];

nodes.notes: One control item after either an empty Phase 5C queue or the completed Phase 5C batch. Handoff to Phase 5D once.

nodes.name: Get Phase 5D Event Records
nodes.notes: Read-only Phase 5D input. Empty results emit one control item so the next stage can finish safely.

nodes.name: Continue After Phase 5D Event Read

parameters.jsCode: return [{ json: { phase5d_control: true } }];

nodes.notes: Collapses a multi-item read to one control item, preventing repeated downstream database reads.

nodes.name: Get Phase 5D Recommendation History
nodes.notes: Read-only Phase 5D input. Empty results emit one control item so the next stage can finish safely.

nodes.name: Prepare Phase 5D Recommendations
nodes.notes: Strict deterministic comparison of actual exact dates, action-title overlap, and specific retained subjects. Emits a control item when no pair qualifies. No model or external call.

nodes.name: Create Phase 5D Recommendation
nodes.notes: Creates only a new latest possible-duplicate recommendation. Existing pairs are skipped or repaired without creating a second latest row.

nodes.name: Append Phase 5D Recommendation Run
nodes.notes: Appends immutable history for a new recommendation or repairs a missing history row with the saved submission key.

nodes.name: Phase 5D Complete
nodes.notes: Review stop. No merge, hiding, reclassification, publishing, or Phase 5E execution.
